justification: Both depict costumed human figures rendered in dense low relief on a tall upright slab, combined with column-arranged block glyph-like signs and scroll/mask ornament, a fairly specific conventional pairing of figure plus sign columns. The clearest difference is in figural composition: B shows a single frontal standing figure filling the shaft with symmetrical regalia, while A shows smaller figures in profile/seated postures beneath a vertical stack of sign blocks, so the specific scene differs even if the vocabulary matches.
